title: Europe’s Scorching Summer
summary: A series of heat waves in 2026 is breaking records and taking a toll in Europe.

The darkest red areas indicate temperatures that met or exceeded 40°C (104°F). NASA Earth Observatory/Lauren Dauphin Western Europe got its first hint of an unusual summer in May 2026, when a heat dome produced exceptional temperatures that shattered records in several countries.
